ideas.label: Active King
ideas.principle: Activate the king when tactical danger has subsided.
ideas.summary: - Centralize the king to attack pawns, support passers, and deny entry squares. - Do not rush pawn pushes while the king still sits on the back rank.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Small Steps to Giant Improvement: Master Pawn Play in Chess

slots.worked: the ending simplified enough for the king to become a fighting piece
slots.attention: the king is still too passive to escort pawns or seize key squares
slots.lesson: centralize the king once tactical danger has subsided
slots.plan: bring the king forward before further pawn advances

ideas.label: Active King
ideas.principle: Convert king activity into restriction before changing the pawn structure.
ideas.summary: - Secure a central outpost and restrict the enemy king first. - Only then create or advance a passed pawn.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Small Steps to Giant Improvement: Master Pawn Play in Chess

slots.worked: your king already claimed useful central ground
slots.attention: the pawn structure still needs changing only after the enemy king is restricted
slots.lesson: convert king activity into restriction before changing the pawn structure
slots.plan: fix a passer only after the opposing king is cut off

ideas.label: Active King
ideas.principle: Use a pawn move to create a protected route for the king.
ideas.summary: - Prefer a tempo-gaining pawn move that opens the king's route. - Avoid pawn rushes that expose new weaknesses before entry.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Small Steps to Giant Improvement: Master Pawn Play in Chess

slots.worked: a pawn lever already opened a path for the king
slots.attention: the king still needs a protected route before the next pawn push
slots.lesson: use a forcing pawn move to create a safe king entry route
